purpose: make obligate-pair nesting interpretable relative to sampling- and taxonomy-matched non-obligate structure rather than raw co-distribution

candidate_pair_requirements: both candidate taxa differ from the focal obligate taxa
candidate x is in the same family as focal x
candidate y is in the same family as focal y
independent literature/interaction screen contains no declared obligate association between candidate x and candidate y
sampling summaries use the identical frozen occurrence preprocessing contract
matched_non_obligate_pairs.spatial_extent_definition: convex hull area in square kilometres of retained occupied EPSG:6933 10-km cell centroids; fewer than 3 non-collinear centroids is not matchable
matched_non_obligate_pairs.selection_rule: filter by every categorical requirement and every caliper, then sort lexicographically by maximum absolute log2 record deviation, maximum absolute log2 unique-cell deviation, maximum absolute log2 effective-cell deviation, maximum absolute log2 extent deviation, then pair_id
matched_non_obligate_pairs.insufficient_control_action: unresolved_controls; do not widen family strata or relax calipers after summaries are opened

candidate_requirements: replacement taxon differs from focal y
replacement is in the same family as focal y
independent interaction screen contains no declared obligate association between focal x and replacement y
replacement y passes the same factor-2 sampling calipers against focal y
shuffled_partner_null.insufficient_replacement_action: unresolved_controls; do not broaden taxonomy or calipers after summaries are opened
